Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, c As PivotCache, p As PivotTable, f As PivotField
Set ws=Worksheets(1)
ws.Range("A1:B1").Value=Array("Region","Amount")
ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("East",10)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("West",20)
ws.Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("East",30)
ws.Range("A5:B5").Value=Array("West",40)
ws.Range("A6:B6").Value=Array("East",50)
On Error GoTo Failed

Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:B6"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E3"),"Made")
Set f=p.AddDataField(p.PivotFields("Amount"),,xlSum)
Probe=f.Name & "|" & CStr(f.Function) & "|" & p.TableRange1.Address & "|" & CStr(VarType(p.DataBodyRange.Cells(1,1).Value2)) & "|" & CStr(p.DataBodyRange.Cells(1,1).Value2)
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
